name: Account Sub Level 17
definition: Account and holding of the next sub-level (Level 7).

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the sub-account between the account owner and the account servicer.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the sub-account.

AccountServicer.name: Account Servicer
AccountServicer.definition: Party that manages the sub-account on behalf of the account owner, that is manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

BeneficialOwner.name: Beneficial Owner
BeneficialOwner.definition: Individual or entity that is ultimately entitled to the benefit of income and rights in a financial instrument, as opposed to a nominal or legal owner.

BalanceDetails.name: Balance Details
BalanceDetails.definition: Report on the net position of a financial instrument on the sub-account (sub-account level 7), for a certain date. The agent, for example, a trade intermediary, may also be specified.

AccountSubLevel8Difference.name: Account Sub Level 8 Difference
AccountSubLevel8Difference.definition: Difference in holdings between the sub-account at level 7 and the sub-accounts of level 8.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
